# kea_dhcp4_subnet (Data Source)

Retrieves a DHCPv4 subnet from the Kea DHCP server by ID or by prefix. Works for subnets from the configuration file as well as subnets managed by `kea_dhcp4_subnet`.

**Important:** Requires the `subnet_cmds` hook library.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a subnet by ID
data "kea_dhcp4_subnet" "office" {
  id = 10
}

# Look up a subnet by prefix
data "kea_dhcp4_subnet" "branch" {
  subnet = "198.51.100.0/24"
}

output "office_pools" {
  value = [for p in data.kea_dhcp4_subnet.office.pools : p.pool]
}

# Reserve an address in a subnet found by prefix
resource "kea_dhcp4_reservation" "printer" {
  subnet_id  = data.kea_dhcp4_subnet.branch.id
  hw_address = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:70"
  ip_address = "198.51.100.70"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Subnet ID. Exactly one of `id` and `subnet` must be set.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet prefix in CIDR notation, as written in the Kea configuration. Exactly one of `id` and `subnet` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `boot_file_name` (String) Boot file name for network booting (`file` field in DHCP packet).
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Classes a client must belong to (at least one) to use the subnet.
- `ddns_generated_prefix` (String) Prefix of generated client names.
- `ddns_override_client_update` (Boolean) Whether forward DNS is updated even when the client asks to do it itself.
- `ddns_override_no_update` (Boolean) Whether DNS is updated even when the client asks the server not to.
- `ddns_qualifying_suffix` (String) Suffix appended to partial client names.
- `ddns_replace_client_name` (String) When the name sent by the client is replaced.
- `ddns_send_updates` (Boolean) Whether DNS updates are sent for leases in this subnet.
- `ddns_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds of the DNS records for leases in this subnet.
- `ddns_update_on_renew` (Boolean) Whether DNS is updated on every lease renewal.
- `evaluate_additional_classes` (Set of String) Classes evaluated after the subnet is selected.
- `interface` (String) Name of the interface the subnet is directly reachable on.
- `max_valid_lifetime` (Number) Maximum lease lifetime in seconds a client may request.
- `min_valid_lifetime` (Number) Minimum lease lifetime in seconds a client may request.
- `next_server` (String) Next server address for network booting (`siaddr` field in DHCP packet).
- `option_data` (Attributes Set) DHCP options configured for this subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_data))
- `pools` (Attributes List) Address pools of the subnet, sorted by address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))
- `rebind_timer` (Number) T2 timer in seconds (Option 59).
- `relay` (Set of String) Addresses of relay agents that forward requests for this subnet.
- `renew_timer` (Number) T1 timer in seconds (Option 58).
- `reservations_global` (Boolean) Whether global host reservations are looked up for clients in this subnet.
- `reservations_in_subnet` (Boolean) Whether host reservations made for this subnet are looked up.
- `reservations_out_of_pool` (Boolean) Whether reserved addresses are assumed to be outside the pools.
- `server_hostname` (String) Server hostname for network booting (`sname` field in DHCP packet).
- `shared_network_name` (String) Name of the shared network the subnet belongs to, if any.
- `user_context` (String) Arbitrary JSON data stored with this subnet.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Lease lifetime in seconds.

### Nested Schema for `option_data`

Read-Only:

- `always_send` (Boolean) Whether this option is always sent to the client.
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Client classes for which this option applies.
- `code` (Number) Option code.
- `csv_format` (Boolean) Whether data is in CSV format (`true`) or raw format (`false`).
- `data` (String) Option value.
- `name` (String) Option name.
- `never_send` (Boolean) Whether this option is never sent to the client.
- `space` (String) Option space.

Read-Only:

- `client_classes` (Set of String) Classes a client must belong to (at least one) to use the pool.

- `option_data` (Attributes Set) DHCP options configured for this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--option_data))
- `pool` (String) Address range, as Kea reports it (`first-last` or a prefix).
